caveats: Five-second samples, two-second per-phase settling and initial scene warmup; full distributions and repeated capped/uncapped baselines retained.
The initial one-rig terrain 60-FPS window included one 1000ms stall; its median was16.69ms and the repeated60-FPS window averaged59.8FPS. No claim that cold/occasional stalls were eliminated.
CPUprocess time sums allUnitythreads; it can exceed framewalltime because threads run concurrently. It excludes independent native tracker processes.
Unavailable release profiling counters remain unavailable; zero managed allocation is not claimed.
